# Quilt Cut Planner

> Free browser-based quilting fabric and rectangular-cut planning calculators. Results depend on real material dimensions and stated construction assumptions; software tests are not physical sewing certification.

Official website: https://quiltcutplanner.com/
Methodology and external references: https://quiltcutplanner.com/about/
Privacy and usage limitations: https://quiltcutplanner.com/privacy/
Source and automated tests: https://github.com/garrison2025/Quilt_Calculator

## Public calculators
- [Full quilt project planner](https://quiltcutplanner.com/calculators/): separate backing, batting, straight-grain binding, butted borders and fabric cut plans.
- [Quilt backing calculator](https://quiltcutplanner.com/quilt-backing-calculator/): rectangular panels, overage, seam take-up and yardage.
- [Straight-grain quilt binding calculator](https://quiltcutplanner.com/quilt-binding-calculator/): full-width strips, joined length and purchase yardage. Does not calculate bias binding.
- [Butted quilt border calculator](https://quiltcutplanner.com/quilt-border-calculator/): side-first layers; no mitered or pieced borders.
- [Fabric yardage calculator](https://quiltcutplanner.com/fabric-yardage-calculator/): repeat rectangle placement and real width-of-fabric constraints.
- [Quilt fabric calculator](https://quiltcutplanner.com/quilt-fabric-calculator/): multi-SKU quilt-top cut lists and layouts.
- [Fabric yards to inches](https://quiltcutplanner.com/fabric-yards-to-inches/): exact length conversion; 1 yard = 36 inches = 91.44 centimeters.
- [Quilt batting calculator](https://quiltcutplanner.com/quilt-batting-calculator/): one-piece fit from a batting roll, without joins.
- [Quilt sashing calculator](https://quiltcutplanner.com/quilt-sashing-calculator/): internal strips and cornerstones in a straight grid.

## Important limits
- Use actual usable width of fabric after trimming selvedges; measure cuts and seam allowances rather than assuming default retail bolt widths.
- Bias binding, diagonal backing, mitered/pieced borders, batting joins and experimental methods are not supported as certified purchase plans.
- The interactive calculators run in the browser; the pages' explanations, formulae and reference examples are published in initial HTML.
- No named sewing expert, institutional affiliation, customer testimonials, physical certification or live store prices are claimed.
- Research/QA routes are intentionally excluded from public search indexing and this curated index.

This file is an optional human- and machine-readable guide; it is not a substitute for HTML, the official sitemap, or Google indexing.
